groups.title: Launchers, Proton & fixes
groups.description: Manage your game libraries and choose compatibility tools for Windows games.

groups.title: Emulation & your library
groups.description: Choose an emulation setup, then organize your games in Steam.

groups.title: Plugins & customization
groups.description: Install Decky Loader first, then add plugins from its stable store.

groups.title: Remote play
groups.description: Play games running on a PC or PlayStation console. The host device is required.

groups.title: Files & desktop utilities
groups.description: Move files between devices and manage Flatpak app permissions.

items.title: Heroic Games Launcher
items.search: heroic games launcher epic gog amazon prime non steam games wine proton library
items.description: Install Epic, GOG, and Amazon Prime Games titles. Manage Wine or Proton and add games to Steam for access in Game Mode.

items.title: ProtonUp-Qt
items.search: protonup qt protonup-qt ge proton compatibility wine versions windows games steamos
items.description: Install community compatibility tools such as GE-Proton. Restart Steam, then select the installed version in a game's Compatibility settings.

items.title: EmuDeck
items.search: emudeck emulation steam deck retro emulators roms setup installer automatic steam library
items.description: Install and configure emulators, then add your own games to Steam. A starting point for setting up an emulation library on the Deck.

items.title: RetroDECK
items.search: retrodeck retro deck emulation emulators emulationstation es de flatpak flathub controller retro games
items.description: A bundled emulation setup with a controller-friendly ES-DE frontend. Install and update through Flathub, then add your own games and required BIOS files.

items.title: Steam ROM Manager
items.search: steam rom manager srm emulation roms artwork steamgriddb non steam shortcuts library parsers
items.description: Add emulated games and non-Steam apps to your library with matching artwork. Configure parsers for the emulators and game folders you already use.

items.title: Decky Loader
items.search: decky loader plugin manager steam deck game mode plugins store open source customization css loader powertools steamgriddb
items.description: Add a plugin menu and community plugin store to Game Mode. Browse customization, artwork, and utility plugins from the Deck's Quick Access menu.

items.title: Moonlight
items.search: moonlight sunshine pc game streaming remote play desktop network wifi host gaming computer
items.description: Stream games from your gaming PC. Set up Sunshine on the host, pair Moonlight, and use a reliable network for responsive remote play.

items.title: chiaki-ng
items.search: chiaki ng chiaki-ng chiaki4deck playstation ps4 ps5 remote play streaming console dualsense
items.description: Stream from your PS4 or PS5 to the Deck. Enable Remote Play on the console, then follow the registration guide to pair the app.

items.title: Lutris
items.search: lutris non steam games launcher windows wine proton installer library shortcuts discover flatpak
items.description: Manage non-Steam games and launchers in one library. Install Lutris through Discover in Desktop Mode, then create Steam shortcuts for the games you want in Game Mode.

items.title: Protontricks
items.search: protontricks winetricks proton windows dependencies components runtimes steam game prefix flatpak discover
items.description: Install game-specific Windows components inside a Steam game's Proton environment. Use its graphical interface when a game's setup instructions call for particular dependencies, rather than changing every game.
items.requirement: Use the dependencies named by the game's setup guide.

items.title: Bottles
items.search: bottles wine windows software programs launchers environments prefixes runners dependencies flatpak discover
items.description: Create separate environments for Windows games and software. Manage runners and dependencies through a graphical interface, then run the installer or program inside its selected bottle in Desktop Mode.
items.requirement: The official supported package is the Flatpak version.

items.title: Flatseal
items.search: flatseal flatpak permissions filesystem folders sd card storage access desktop discover sandbox
items.description: Review permissions for Flatpak apps and grant access to a particular game folder when needed. Select the affected app, change its permissions, then restart it to apply the changes.
items.requirement: Applies to Flatpak apps; choose the specific folder they need.

items.title: LocalSend
items.search: localsend local send files transfer phone pc android ios wifi network desktop appimage flatpak
items.description: Transfer files between your Deck, phone, and PC over the same local network. Install LocalSend on both devices, select the receiving device, and accept the transfer without creating an account.
items.requirement: Both devices need LocalSend and access to the same local network.

items.title: CSS Loader
items.description: Customize the Steam interface with community CSS themes. Install the plugin through Decky, then choose and manage themes from its menu.
items.requirement: Requires Decky Loader; install through its built-in stable store.

items.title: SteamGridDB
items.description: Change library artwork, icons, and game images in Game Mode, including non-Steam shortcuts. Open a game's context menu and choose Change Artwork.
items.requirement: Requires Decky Loader; install through its built-in stable store.

items.title: ProtonDB Badges
items.description: Show tappable ProtonDB community compatibility badges on game pages. Open the reports to compare other players' settings and experiences with a title.
items.requirement: Requires Decky Loader; install through its built-in stable store.

items.title: PowerTools
items.description: Adjust CPU, GPU, and battery controls with per-game settings. For manual tuning: change one setting at a time and keep defaults available to restore.
items.requirement: Requires Decky Loader. Advanced manual tuning; results depend on the game.

items.title: Syncthing
items.description: Keep selected folders synchronized between your Deck and another device. Pair the devices, choose a shared folder, and monitor transfers through its browser-based interface in Desktop Mode.
items.requirement: Keep Syncthing running on both devices. Changes and deletions can synchronize.

items.title: Filelight
items.description: Find which folders use the most space using an interactive ring map. Scan your home folder or a selected drive, then explore larger directories before deciding what to manage.

items.title: PeaZip
items.description: Browse and extract ZIP, RAR, 7Z, and TAR archives in Desktop Mode. Review the contents and choose an output folder while keeping the original archive available.

items.title: TabMaster
items.description: Create, reorder, filter, and hide library tabs in Game Mode. Build a tab for a collection, installed games, or non-Steam titles to make a large library easier to browse.
items.requirement: Requires Decky Loader; install through its stable plugin store.

items.title: HLTB for Deck
items.description: Display HowLongToBeat completion-time estimates on game pages. Open View Details for the source listing and adjust the information bar from the plugin menu.
items.requirement: Estimates depend on HowLongToBeat data and its availability.
items.search: HLTB for Deck Decky game-length estimates

items.title: Storage Cleaner
items.description: Inspect per-game shader-cache and compatibility-data usage from Game Mode. Identify space usage before considering selective cleanup; compatibility folders can also contain game settings and saves.
items.requirement: Requires Decky Loader. Review data and backups before removing anything.

items.title: Bluetooth
items.description: Reconnect already paired headphones, controllers, and other Bluetooth devices from Quick Access while a game is running.
items.requirement: Pair new devices in Steam Settings first; this plugin is a shortcut to existing pairings.

items.title: Pause Games
items.description: Pause and resume a running game from Quick Access, or optionally pause it when it loses focus. Useful for switching between applications without closing them.
items.requirement: Paused games keep their RAM and VRAM. Save first and test with an offline game; some games do not resume reliably.

items.title: Audio Loader
items.description: Replace Steam interface sound effects with sound packs from the built-in Pack Manager. Browse packs and try one at a time from Game Mode.
items.requirement: Requires Decky Loader. Sound packs are downloaded separately through the plugin.

items.title: Animation Changer
items.description: Browse and install startup animations, choose an installed animation, or randomize your selection on boot. Manage the selection from Quick Access.
items.requirement: Requires Decky Loader. Animation files are separate downloads; Steam customization settings can affect which movie plays.

items.title: AutoFlatpaks
items.description: Check and install Flatpak app updates without switching to Desktop Mode. Start with manual checks, then choose whether to enable notifications or automatic updates.
items.requirement: Requires root permissions through Decky. Supports system-installed Flatpaks; user-installed apps and extra installation locations are not supported.

items.title: Quick Launch
items.description: Launch desktop applications from the Quick Access menu and add shortcuts to your Steam library. Useful for opening an already installed utility from Game Mode.
items.requirement: Limited maintenance: the author cannot promise fixes. The plugin supports one application at a time; Steam library shortcuts remain an alternative.

researchNotes: Lutris, Protontricks, Flatseal and Bottles use rolling stable Flathub online installer references. These references are not offline application bundles or fixed application-version downloads.

KDE Connect was not added as a downloadable tool: https://dl.flathub.org/repo/appstream/org.kde.kdeconnect.flatpakref returned HTTP 404. Its official download page at https://kdeconnect.kde.org/download.html remains a useful reference; the linked KDE UserBase pairing page returned HTTP 403 through web lookup.
